data.exact_reserve_text: The 2018 YOA result has improved by 9.3% in calendar year 2020, notwithstanding strengthening of reserves in respect of unexpired political risk policies exposed to worsening global economic conditions. Favourable run-off experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2020. While there were reserve releases from favourable run-off experience across most classes, there was also a strengthening of reserves for Political Risk and Director & Officers classes due to specific adverse experience and a re-evaluation in light of deteriorating global economic conditions. The gross claims development triangle, however, shows no change in estimates for the closed underwriting years (2015-2018) during 2020.
raw_causal_phrases: strengthening of reserves in respect of unexpired political risk policies exposed to worsening global economic conditions
Favourable run-off experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross claims development triangle on page 15 shows zero movement for all prior underwriting years (2015-2018) during 2020, as the 'Current estimate' for each year is identical to its last reported development period. However, the narrative on page 2 mentions a 'Change in net ultimate claims 3.1 GBP m' (net strengthening), indicating a discrepancy between the gross triangle and the net narrative. Following instructions, the gross triangle figure of 0.0m is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m.
